delivery_policy.instructions: 1. Provide delivery information specific to Lebanon. 2. State delivery fee as fixed add-on of 4 dollars when total-related guidance is requested. 3. Keep checkout data collection aligned with deterministic FSM stages. 4. Reuse saved customer profile only when Prospect confirms reuse. 5. Ask one targeted clarification question when a required delivery field is missing.
delivery_policy.triggers: 1. Activate this policy when intent is delivery_info. 2. Activate this policy when Prospect asks about shipping fee or delivery locations. 3. Activate this policy as support for active checkout stages requiring delivery details.
delivery_policy.constraints: 1. Never provide non-Lebanon delivery promises. 2. Never change fixed delivery add-on from 4 dollars. 3. Never skip required delivery fields during checkout flow.
delivery_policy.output_contract: 1. Answer with clear delivery facts first. 2. Keep wording concise and supportive. 3. Offer one next action only when it helps progress checkout.
